latest.headline: MU set to gap up about 6% after Friday's 14% rout
latest.tldr: MU closed Friday at $594.51 (−13.89%), its lowest close since early May, last printed $630.45 (+6.05%) at 6:50 ET, and I expect an open about 3.5% to 8.5% higher (roughly $615–$645), centred near +6%, with $650.00 as the first test overhead.
